title: Move Shared Shadcn Setup To Elements Ui
description: Move shadcn configuration and shared ownership from semio/sketchpad into elements/ui so UI packages consume a single general setup. Update affected workspace configuration and references, validate commands/configs, and keep changes in existing files where possible.
summary: Moved the canonical shadcn setup into elements/ui, exported the shared tailwindConfig from @elements/ui, exposed components.json from the shared package, redirected sketchpad's legacy shadcn config to generate into elements/ui, and validated both elements/ui and semio/sketchpad with TypeScript.
